adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` do `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` (no nil check). If the record is missing, `save_host` will dereference `host.host = ...` and `destroy` will call `destroy` on `nil`, raising `NoMethodError` and producing a 500 instead of a 404/JSON error. Additionally, `save_host` unconditionally dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]`, so a request without the `embeddable_host` envelope will also 500. On the frontend, `destroyRecord().then(...)` in `embeddable-host.js.es6` has no `.catch(...)`, so a failed destroy won’t surface an error and the row won’t be removed.
